prompt: My Xcode build is failing randomly with 'Module not found' but I know the framework exists in my project.
expected: Classify as Derived Data/cache corruption; quit Xcode if possible; delete $HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData; restart Xcode; note that xcodebuild clean is often not enough.
actual: Identified stale Derived Data, recommended rm -rf "$HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData" and restart, and avoided broader destructive resets first.

prompt: I'm setting up a CI/CD pipeline to archive my iOS app using xcodebuild. The build succeeds in the simulator but the archive step fails with 'No signing certificate'.
expected: Explain archive defaults to Release and needs real signing; simulator success is insufficient proof; prefer manual signing on CI; mention keychain/cert/profile checks and that -allowProvisioningUpdates is not enough alone.
actual: Separated simulator Debug from Release archive requirements, required valid cert+profile/team, and treated automatic signing as unreliable for headless CI.

prompt: Release build dropped half our GCC_PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS after I set a target override. Debug still works.
expected: Explain settings hierarchy and $(inherited); show comparing Debug vs Release via xcodebuild -showBuildSettings; fix by appending with $(inherited) instead of replacing.
actual: Called out missing $(inherited) replacement behavior and used -showBuildSettings on Release to verify the winning flags.
